verdict.rationale: E2B ships an official, well-documented CLI that manages and interacts with sandboxes and templates (e2b-docs-9, e2b-probe-4). It covers creating sandboxes with an interactive terminal, connecting, listing by state, background command execution, snapshots, metrics, shutdown, and multi-project auth. Env-var API-key auth is documented for non-interactive environments like CI/CD, which suits automated and agent workflows. missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of CLI usage, explicit evidence of agent-oriented output modes (e.g. machine-readable/JSON output).
